screen.nscapebeyond.flash_warning.title: WARNING: Flashing Lights
screen.nscapebeyond.flash_warning.body: Nullscape Beyond is a mod that contains flashing lights and rapidly changing visuals that may trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. A Photosensitive option is available in the mod's configuration file or inside the mod configuration tab. Player discretion is advised.
